entities.name: Transformer
entities.description: Architecture relying entirely on attention to draw global dependencies between input and output, introduced in 'Attention Is All You Need'

entities.name: Attention Is All You Need
entities.description: 2017 paper by Vaswani et al. introducing the Transformer architecture

entities.name: RNN
entities.description: Recurrent Neural Network; sequential architecture that Transformers were designed to outperform on long-range dependencies

entities.name: LSTM
entities.description: Long Short-Term Memory network; recurrent architecture preceding the Transformer for sequence modeling

entities.name: Self-Attention
entities.description: Mechanism letting each token attend to all other tokens simultaneously, computed via Query/Key/Value matrices

entities.name: Multi-Head Attention
entities.description: Running multiple attention operations in parallel across different representation subspaces, each head learning different relationship types

entities.name: BERT
entities.description: Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers; Google's 2018 model applying the Transformer encoder for bidirectional context

entities.name: Masked Language Modeling
entities.description: BERT pretraining task masking random tokens and predicting them from bidirectional left and right context

entities.name: Next Sentence Prediction
entities.description: BERT pretraining task predicting whether two sentences are consecutive in the original text

entities.name: RoBERTa
entities.description: BERT variant cited in the document among models dominating NLP understanding benchmarks

entities.name: DistilBERT
entities.description: Distilled BERT variant cited in the document among models dominating NLP understanding benchmarks

entities.name: ALBERT
entities.description: BERT variant cited in the document among models dominating NLP understanding benchmarks

entities.name: GPT
entities.description: Generative Pre-trained Transformer; OpenAI's autoregressive model applying the Transformer decoder

entities.name: GPT-2
entities.description: GPT successor cited in the document's GPT lineage of autoregressive generation models

entities.name: GPT-3
entities.description: 175-billion-parameter GPT successor that demonstrated scaling dramatically improves few-shot and zero-shot performance

entities.name: GPT-4
entities.description: 2023 GPT successor introducing multimodal capability and improved reasoning via RLHF alignment

entities.name: RLHF
entities.description: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback; alignment technique used to improve GPT-4's reasoning and behavior

entities.name: Retrieval Augmented Generation
entities.description: Lewis et al.'s 2020 method combining parametric model knowledge with non-parametric retrieval from external documents

entities.name: RAG Paper
entities.description: Lewis et al. 2020 paper introducing Retrieval-Augmented Generation

entities.name: Vector-Based RAG
entities.description: Standard RAG variant using dense vector embeddings and a vector database to retrieve top-K similar documents

entities.name: Embedding Model
entities.description: Model converting text into high-dimensional numerical vectors, such as text-embedding-3-small or sentence-transformers

entities.name: text-embedding-3-small
entities.description: OpenAI embedding model cited in the document for converting text into vector representations

entities.name: Sentence Transformers
entities.description: Library for computing dense sentence embeddings, cited as an embedding-model option for RAG

entities.name: FAISS
entities.description: Facebook AI Similarity Search; vector database cited for indexing documents in vector-based RAG

entities.name: Pinecone
entities.description: Managed vector database cited as an option for indexing documents in vector-based RAG

entities.name: ChromaDB
entities.description: Open-source vector database cited (as 'Chroma') for indexing documents in vector-based RAG

entities.name: Weaviate
entities.description: Vector database cited as an option for indexing documents in vector-based RAG

entities.name: Cosine Similarity
entities.description: Similarity metric used to match queries against indexed documents in vector-based RAG

entities.name: Inner Product Search
entities.description: Alternative similarity search method cited alongside cosine similarity for matching queries to documents

entities.name: Knowledge Graph
entities.description: Directed graph of entities and named relationships enabling multi-hop reasoning, as described in the document

entities.name: Multi-Hop Reasoning
entities.description: Traversing graph edges from a seed entity to discover related entities multiple hops away

entities.name: GraphRAG
entities.description: Approach combining knowledge graph traversal with LLM generation instead of retrieving flat top-K text chunks

entities.name: TigerGraph
entities.description: Native parallel graph database for large-scale graph analytics, used for GraphRAG knowledge graph storage

entities.name: GSQL
entities.description: TigerGraph's query language supporting multi-hop traversals, pattern matching, and distributed parallel computation

entities.name: TigerGraph Savanna
entities.description: TigerGraph's managed cloud offering providing hosted graph database clusters with REST API and Python SDK access

entities.name: SetAccum
entities.description: GSQL accumulator type used for collecting vertices and edges during graph traversal

entities.name: ListAccum
entities.description: GSQL accumulator type used for collecting ordered vertices and edges during graph traversal

entities.name: Multi-Hop SELECT Traversal
entities.description: GSQL query pattern for n-hop neighborhood queries across a distributed graph

entities.name: Shortest Path Algorithm
entities.description: Built-in TigerGraph algorithm cited for finding shortest paths across the graph

entities.name: Centrality Algorithm
entities.description: Built-in TigerGraph algorithm cited for measuring node importance in the graph

entities.name: Token Efficiency
entities.description: Property of GraphRAG where a serialized subgraph requires far fewer tokens than equivalent raw document chunks

entities.name: GPT-4o-mini
entities.description: OpenAI model cited in the document's token-cost example for production-scale RAG/GraphRAG pricing

entities.name: Claude Opus
entities.description: Anthropic model cited in the document as an example of a high-cost model where token savings scale higher

entities.name: BERTScore
entities.description: Evaluation metric computing semantic similarity between generated and reference answers using contextual BERT embeddings

entities.name: LLM-as-a-Judge
entities.description: Evaluation technique using a capable LLM to grade generated answers on correctness, completeness, relevance, and clarity

entities.name: Faithfulness
entities.description: Evaluation metric measuring whether generated claims are supported by the retrieved context

entities.name: Groundedness
entities.description: Evaluation metric ensuring answers are based on retrieved facts rather than model hallucinations

entities.name: Entity
entities.description: A real-world object — person, organization, concept, event, location — represented as a node in a knowledge graph

entities.name: Relationship
entities.description: A named, directed connection between two entities in a knowledge graph, such as works_at or founded_by

entities.name: Token
entities.description: Basic unit of text processed by LLMs, central to the document's token-efficiency cost analysis

entities.name: Context Window
entities.description: Span of tokens an LLM can attend to, populated either with raw chunks or a compact serialized subgraph

entities.name: Top-K Retrieval
entities.description: Retrieving the top-K most similar documents to a query, the standard vector-RAG retrieval step

entities.name: Document Chunk
entities.description: Segment of a source document indexed and retrieved as raw text context in vector-based RAG

entities.name: Subgraph Serialization
entities.description: Converting a retrieved knowledge graph subgraph into structured text context for the LLM

entities.name: Claude
entities.description: Anthropic's large language model family focused on helpfulness and safety

entities.name: Gemini
entities.description: Google DeepMind's multimodal large language model family

entities.name: LLaMA
entities.description: Open-weight large language model family from Meta AI

entities.name: Mistral
entities.description: Efficient open-weight large language model family

entities.name: CNN
entities.description: Convolutional Neural Network; architecture using convolutional filters for spatial feature extraction

entities.name: Cross-Attention
entities.description: Attention mechanism linking tokens from two different sequences, e.g. encoder and decoder

entities.name: Autoregressive Generation
entities.description: Generating the next token conditioned on all previous tokens, the basis of GPT-style decoding

entities.name: Fine-Tuning
entities.description: Continuing training of a pretrained model on a smaller task-specific dataset

entities.name: LoRA
entities.description: Low-Rank Adaptation; parameter-efficient fine-tuning via small trainable rank decompositions

entities.name: Quantization
entities.description: Reducing numerical precision of model weights/activations to shrink size and speed inference

entities.name: Prompt Engineering
entities.description: Designing input prompts to steer model behavior without changing weights

entities.name: Chain-of-Thought Prompting
entities.description: Prompting strategy eliciting intermediate reasoning steps before a final answer

entities.name: Few-Shot Learning
entities.description: Learning a task from a small number of in-context examples

entities.name: Zero-Shot Learning
entities.description: Performing a task with no task-specific examples, relying on general pretraining

entities.name: Knowledge Distillation
entities.description: Training a smaller student model to mimic a larger teacher model

entities.name: Tokenization
entities.description: Splitting raw text into discrete tokens for model processing

entities.name: Beam Search
entities.description: Decoding strategy that keeps multiple candidate sequences at each generation step

entities.name: Temperature Sampling
entities.description: Decoding strategy scaling logits to control randomness of generated tokens

entities.name: Top-P Sampling
entities.description: Nucleus sampling restricting candidates to a cumulative probability mass

entities.name: Re-ranking
entities.description: Reordering retrieved candidates by a finer-grained relevance model

entities.name: Document Chunking
entities.description: Splitting long documents into smaller passages for retrieval and indexing

entities.name: Sliding Window Chunking
entities.description: Chunking strategy using overlapping windows to preserve cross-boundary context

entities.name: Query Expansion
entities.description: Augmenting a search query with related terms to improve retrieval recall

entities.name: LangChain
entities.description: Framework for composing LLM calls, tools, and memory into application chains

entities.name: LangGraph
entities.description: Graph-based orchestration framework for stateful multi-agent and multi-step LLM workflows

entities.name: Hugging Face Transformers
entities.description: Library providing pretrained transformer models and training utilities

entities.name: PyTorch
entities.description: Deep learning framework with dynamic computation graphs

entities.name: TensorFlow
entities.description: Deep learning framework with static and eager execution modes

entities.name: ONNX Runtime
entities.description: Cross-platform inference engine for models exported to the ONNX format

entities.name: Milvus
entities.description: Open-source vector database designed for large-scale similarity search

entities.name: pgvector
entities.description: PostgreSQL extension adding native vector similarity search support

entities.name: Neo4j
entities.description: Native graph database using the Cypher query language

entities.name: Embedding
entities.description: Dense vector representation of text or tokens enabling semantic similarity search

entities.name: Positional Encoding
entities.description: Representation injecting sequence-order information into token embeddings

entities.name: Sentence Embedding
entities.description: Single dense vector representing the meaning of an entire sentence

entities.name: Graph Embedding
entities.description: Vector representation of nodes or subgraphs preserving structural relationships

entities.name: Semantic Search
entities.description: Retrieval based on meaning similarity rather than exact keyword match

entities.name: Hybrid Search
entities.description: Retrieval combining dense vector similarity with sparse keyword matching

entities.name: Agentic AI
entities.description: Systems where an LLM plans, calls tools, and acts iteratively toward a goal

entities.name: Multi-Agent System
entities.description: Multiple cooperating or competing autonomous agents solving a shared task

entities.name: Tool Calling
entities.description: Mechanism letting an LLM invoke external functions or APIs as part of its reasoning

entities.name: Function Calling
entities.description: Structured interface letting an LLM request execution of a named function with arguments

entities.name: Agent Memory
entities.description: Persistent state an agent retains across steps or sessions

entities.name: Context Engineering
entities.description: Deliberately shaping what information is placed in a model's context window

entities.name: Grounding
entities.description: Anchoring model outputs to verifiable external facts or sources

entities.name: Self-RAG
entities.description: RAG variant where the model decides when and what to retrieve during generation

entities.name: Corrective RAG
entities.description: RAG variant that evaluates and corrects retrieved evidence before generation

entities.name: Agentic RAG
entities.description: RAG architecture where an agent plans multiple retrieval and reasoning steps

entities.name: Long-Context Modeling
entities.description: Techniques enabling models to effectively use very large context windows

entities.name: Co-occurrence
entities.description: Statistical pattern of two entities appearing together within the same text span

entities.name: Hallucination
entities.description: LLM generation of false or unsupported information not grounded in data or retrieval

entities.name: Catastrophic Forgetting
entities.description: Loss of previously learned knowledge when a model is fine-tuned on new data

entities.name: Vanishing Gradient
entities.description: Gradients shrinking through deep networks, stalling learning in early layers

entities.name: Overfitting
entities.description: Model fitting training data noise rather than generalizable patterns

entities.name: Exposure Bias
entities.description: Train/inference mismatch in autoregressive models from never seeing their own errors during training

entities.name: Context Length Limitation
entities.description: Constraint on how much text a model can consider at once

entities.name: Gradient Descent
entities.description: Iterative optimization algorithm minimizing a loss function via parameter updates

entities.name: Backpropagation
entities.description: Algorithm computing gradients of a loss with respect to network weights via the chain rule

entities.name: Adam Optimizer
entities.description: Adaptive gradient-based optimizer combining momentum and per-parameter learning rates

entities.name: SHAP
entities.description: Shapley Additive Explanations; game-theoretic method for feature attribution

entities.name: BFS Traversal
entities.description: Breadth-first search algorithm exploring a graph level by level from seed nodes

entities.name: Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
entities.description: Algorithm finding near-closest vectors quickly by trading exactness for speed

entities.name: BLEU Score
entities.description: Metric scoring machine translation/generation quality via n-gram overlap

entities.name: Perplexity
entities.description: Metric measuring how well a language model predicts a sample of text

entities.name: F1 Score
entities.description: Harmonic mean of precision and recall used to evaluate classification

entities.name: Recall@K
entities.description: Metric measuring whether relevant items appear within the top K retrieved results

entities.name: Precision@K
entities.description: Metric measuring what fraction of the top K retrieved results are relevant

entities.name: OpenAI
entities.description: AI research and product company behind the GPT model family and text-embedding models

entities.name: Anthropic
entities.description: AI safety-focused company behind the Claude model family

entities.name: Meta AI
entities.description: Meta's AI research division behind the LLaMA model family

entities.name: Google DeepMind
entities.description: Google's AI research division behind Gemini and prior DeepMind research

entities.name: Groq
entities.description: Company providing high-throughput low-latency LLM inference hardware and API
